mapper.select: SELECT pe.*, ei.item_name, sm.meeting_name FROM personal_entry pe LEFT JOIN event_item ei ON pe.item_id = ei.item_id LEFT JOIN sports_meeting sm ON pe.meeting_id = sm.meeting_id WHERE pe.user_id = #{userId} AND pe.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY pe.create_time DESC

SELECT pe.*, ei.item_name, sm.meeting_name FROM personal_entry pe LEFT JOIN event_item ei ON pe.item_id = ei.item_id LEFT JOIN sports_meeting sm ON pe.meeting_id = sm.meeting_id WHERE pe.entry_id = #{entryId} AND pe.del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM personal_entry WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status != 2 AND del_flag = 0
